title: P6 Shipping audit and authorized corrections — 2026-10-09

sections.title: Independent audit verdict and owner authority
sections.text: Initial independent audit of baseline 6a0a37d: RED (3 Major). P6.1–P6.7 were implemented by other sessions; this session performed one audit without subagents. Owner explicitly authorized execution, commit and push: «и ты же исполняешь его, потом коммит и пуш». Corrections follow this verdict as execution work, not a second independent review.

sections.title: Findings and owning items
sections.text:
A1 — Major — P6.1. packages/shipping/src/Rates/Internal/RateCodec.php:66–92. Stored-rate decode catches only UnsupportedContribution and InvalidRateConfig; a RuntimeException/Error in contribution resolution, version(), upgrade() or normalize() escapes MethodPricer (decode is outside its price try/catch) and MethodRows. One broken plugin therefore aborts all options/explain and admin method reads instead of marking its tariff unsupported (SHP-05). Repair: contain every plugin loading failure on the read path; keep writes strict; regression tests through codec, options and admin reads.

A2 — Major — P6.6. packages/shipping/src/Bookings/Internal/CarrierShipmentBooking.php:62–66,101–111. The mutable current method is checked before the journal. Book a shipment, archive the method or change its carrier, then repeat the identical BookShipment: MethodArchived/CarrierMismatch prevents returning the durable result. For unknown/expired pending, the same change prevents Carrier::find and strands a possibly existing shipment. Repair: the journal is authoritative for existing booked/recovery attempts; method validation applies to a first/new rejected attempt. Preserve fingerprint conflict, lease and fencing protections; unavailable original carrier fails closed.

A3 — Major — P6.6. packages/shipping/src/Bookings/Internal/CarrierShipmentBooking.php:163–176; packages/shipping/src/Bookings/Internal/BookingJournal.php:230–238. isMeta accepts scalar string keys/values containing NUL, and JSON encoding succeeds; PostgreSQL jsonb rejects \u0000. A carrier-created shipment then raises QueryException during finish and stays pending rather than unknown with shipping.invalid_carrier_result. Evidence: isolated PostgreSQL query select a JSON object with note=\u0000 cast to jsonb returns unsupported Unicode escape sequence. Repair: validate PostgreSQL-representable UTF-8 metadata before finish, on both book and find paths; regression tests assert unknown state and no event.

sections.title: Evidence and validation

Existing successful checks were not rerun during read-only audit because inputs have not changed. PHP 8.4.26 verified; PostgreSQL on 127.0.0.1:54329 reachable; current_database()=commerz_test, migration registry present. Audit session: codex/gpt-6.1-sol/high, 01a1226b-d5ee-7bc0-82a0-e83b76577c1a (observed turn_context).

sections.title: Authorized correction scope
sections.text: Repair A1 in P6.1 and A2/A3 in P6.6, add focused behavioral regressions, update shipping-design and architecture documents for journal authority, synchronize plans/ACTIVE.md, and run affected Composer acceptance checks. Preserve historical execution receipts; record new correction evidence separately. P7 remains the next phase outside this request.
